en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a striking modernist church set on a gently sloping, grassy hill scattered with rocks and bordered by evergreen trees. The building has a sharply angled, A‑frame style roof and a tall, triangular bell tower with several openings and a cross on top. Large glass windows and white railings emphasize the contemporary design, likely from the mid‑20th century. The sky is partly cloudy and there are no people visible.
